answer.answer: Implementation `sum(p)/len(p)` is correct for non-empty lists but violates the contract for empty list: it raises ZeroDivisionError instead of returning 0. Minimal fix: return 0 when list is empty, e.g. `return 0 if len(p)==0 else sum(p)/len(p)`.
